params.caption: 🕹️ A jailbroken PS4 is now running a 9-billion-parameter AI model An open-source project called Garlic LLM runs Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B model fully offline on the GPU of a jailbroken PlayStation 4. It skips the drivers and talks straight to the 2013-era graphics chip, reaching roughly 31–39 tokens per second, with peaks up to 43. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 16:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @PlayStation 🤯 React if your old PS4 just got interesting · 💬 What should they run on it next? #PS4 #PlayStation #AI #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
